thread:
zoe-people-ops: FYI the Airbnb for the recruiting offsite showed a $600 authorization on the corp card but the final charge was $720. Host added a cleaning fee after checkout. I paid the extra $120 on my personal card to avoid a dispute. Need reimbursement and guidance on how to code cleaning fees.

harry-ops: Oof that's annoying. Did the host update the Airbnb reservation or charge a separate payout? I think authorizations sometimes differ from final.

zoe-people-ops: Host messaged that a deep-clean was needed and they charged an additional cleaning payout after our stay. The Airbnb payout shows two transactions: AUTH $600 (pre-checkin) and POST $720 (after). I attached the Airbnb payout email and the final invoice PDF.

nora-finance: Thanks Zoe. Two items: 1) We reimburse personal payments that were business-related if you provide proof (final Airbnb invoice + bank posted USD amount). 2) For bookkeeping, cleaning fees are generally allowable as part of lodging if incurred by the host. We'll code to GL 6102 but tag as "cleaning fee - host adjustment".

phil-corpcard: Note: corporate card refers to the authorization amount for holds, but the posted charge is what matters. If the corp card still shows $600 only (authorization not captured), we need to confirm whether the host processed the additional $120 to the corp card or to your card. If they charged your card, we'll reimburse you; if they posted to corp card later, that will auto-adjust in Ramp.

zoe-people-ops: The host charged the extra to a saved payment method (their notes say "guest card on file"). Airbnb forwarded the charge to my personal card ending 3344. So it's on me.

nora-finance: OK please upload the final Airbnb invoice and a screenshot of your bank showing the posted $720 and the breakdown if available. If your bank shows only a single $720 charge, we will reimburse the additional $120 net of the $600 the corp card already covered. Attach messages from host that describe the charge for audit trail.

expensebot: ExpenseBot: Parsed attachments. Flag: split between corp-authorized amount and guest-posted final. Missing: bank posted transaction screenshot for personal card. Recommended: include host message and invoice.

zoe-people-ops: Uploaded bank screenshot and host message. Quick question: does the cleaning portion need manager approval if over policy? The extra was $120 (cleaning only).

nora-finance: Cleaning as part of lodging is allowed. Manager approval only required for meals/alcohol over limits or for unusual personal charges. This is fine. We'll reimburse the $120. Submit in Ramp as "Travel - Lodging (Airbnb)" GL 6102 and add note "host charged additional cleaning fee after checkout; corp card authorization covered $600; personal card covered remainder".

phil-corpcard: Also note: in cases where an authorization was captured but final posted higher, Ramp may show a declined/failed capture for the auth. Finance reconcile will match the posted amounts; please include both auth and posted screenshots for clarity.

harry-ops: For future hires, we should remind hosts to update reservation before checkout. Small ops note.

zoe-people-ops: Submitted in Ramp with all attachments. Thanks all.

expensebot: ExpenseBot: Reminder: submit within 30 days. Reimbursement ETA ~5-7 business days after finance approval.

nora-finance: I'll review today and route for approval. If anything else missing I'll ping here.

zoe-people-ops: Great, appreciate the quick help.
